title: 2022 (10k Project)
statement: One square of pixels for each of 10,000 frens... because NFTs are people.
collaborator: Dr Matthew Hirschey, Duke University ... Digital Artist Economy student; wrote the organising scripts

works.title: 10k Project
works.statement: 10k Project is a commentary on the dominance of profile pictures (pfp) as NFT culture. NFT collectors and traders are nudged by 10k project founders to swap their Twitter profile picture to spread the initial success of their project. Most 10k projects receive a flash of prominence, yet only a few make to be perceived as a blue-chip success. Less obvious, is **how many of us bond with our profile picture** beyond its trade-able value and keep it as our new Web3.0 identity. Shown in this 1/1 artwork titled ‘10k Project’ is the pure diversity on show across the many 10k projects created to date. Each square of pixels represents one of 10,000 frens who followed [@mintfaced](https://twitter.com/mintfaced) between April 2021 and April 2022 because NFTs are people. Can you see your Web3.0 identity anon? Title: 10k Project Artist: MintFace x Matthew Hirschey Resolution: 4800 x 4800 Size: 22.9Mb

works.title: 10k Project Black and White
works.statement: This 10k project is a love letter to the first 10,000 mint faces who joined in the NFT fun in 2021/2022 by followed @MintFaced on Twitter. Thank you for joining NFTs and making the community what it has become.

works.title: 10k Ghosted
works.statement: 10K Ghosted illustrates the ephemeral nature of community in NFTs. While 10K Project celebrated the rise of the MintFace community, 10K Ghosted commiserates those NFT frens who faded away in the crypto winter of 2022. Each black pixel represents a person who stopped tweeting in May 2022, and likely stopped creating or collecting art altogether. 🥃 Pour one out for frens no longer here. If you are still part of the 10K Project, congratulations 🎉 Artist Collab: MintFace x Matthew Hirschey

works.title: 10k Phunks v3
works.statement: 10k Phunks introduces more frens to the concept of 'Phunkism'. Phunkism is about finding your voice and how you fit into this space and finding how you might contribute. Phunkism is an inspiration. Inspiring yourself and inspiring others to buidl. Go for it. Buidl your vision for a phunky Web3.0 future.
